what: S6: (1) T-0091 looped to escalation 3 on a lint error (rules-of-hooks) caused by T-0090 naming a function useDevEmailTransport; T-0091 could not edit that file, so no retry could fix it, then route-exhausted at the top tier. (2) T-0089 and T-0090 both wrote a dev console email sender; T-0089's printed raw email text and tripped the R-020 log lint. (3) T-0164 (route integration) blocked correctly: the real path (S5 submit-deps/submit-emails) already queues and sends emails, S6 modules are parallel, and its named e2e spec did not exist.
rule: A lint/test failure in a file other than the ticket's outputs must route to the owning ticket, not escalate the current one; a done ticket's integration must not pass with a failed check; split modules in the same stage must not each implement the same sender; integration tickets must name a test fi
fix: Runner: attribute failures to the owner of the named file; hold ticket->done when any integrate check failed; scope split: one owner per capability across the stage and let the integration ticket own the test file; init: untrack tsbuildinfo.
